title: FAIR-R²L Checklist
description: A guided assessment for FAIRness, AI readiness and responsible licensing.
method_note: The IP4OS checklist does not define an official scoring algorithm. This prototype uses transparent equal-weight readiness and completion calculations.

sections.title: Findable
sections.short_description: Can people and machines identify and discover the dataset?

questions.text: Does the dataset have a persistent identifier such as a DOI?
questions.recommendation: Assign a DOI or another persistent identifier.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the DOI, Handle or another persistent identifier.

questions.text: Does the dataset have a clear title?
questions.recommendation: Add a concise, descriptive title.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the dataset title.

questions.text: Are the creators or responsible organisations named?
questions.recommendation: Add creator or organisation information.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide creator names or responsible organisations.

questions.text: Are useful keywords or subjects provided?
questions.recommendation: Add keywords that help others discover the dataset.
questions.evidence_hint: List relevant keywords or subject terms.

questions.text: Is the dataset registered in a searchable repository?
questions.recommendation: Publish the dataset in a searchable repository.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the repository name or landing-page URL.

sections.title: Accessible
sections.short_description: Can users retrieve the dataset or understand how to request access?

questions.text: Can the dataset or its metadata be retrieved?
questions.recommendation: Provide a stable and retrievable landing page.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the dataset or metadata URL.

questions.text: Is a standard access method such as HTTPS used?
questions.recommendation: Use a standard retrieval protocol such as HTTPS.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the access URL or protocol.

questions.text: Are the access conditions clearly stated?
questions.recommendation: State whether access is open, restricted, controlled or embargoed.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe the access conditions.

questions.text: Is machine-readable metadata available?
questions.recommendation: Expose metadata through a repository API or standard metadata endpoint.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the metadata endpoint or repository API.

questions.text: If access is restricted, is the request procedure explained?
questions.recommendation: Explain who may request access and how approval works.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe the access request and approval process.

sections.title: Interoperable
sections.short_description: Can the metadata and files work with other systems and standards?

questions.text: Is the metadata machine-readable?
questions.recommendation: Provide metadata in a machine-readable format.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the metadata format or endpoint.

questions.text: Are controlled vocabularies or standard terms used?
questions.recommendation: Use documented vocabularies or controlled terms.
questions.evidence_hint: Name the vocabulary, ontology or terminology used.

questions.text: Are persistent creator identifiers such as ORCID provided?
questions.recommendation: Add ORCID or another persistent creator identifier.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide creator identifiers.

questions.text: Are related datasets, papers or software linked?
questions.recommendation: Add qualified links to related resources.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide related identifiers or URLs.

questions.text: Are the file formats clearly documented?
questions.recommendation: Document file formats and MIME types.
questions.evidence_hint: List the files and their formats.

sections.title: Reusable
sections.short_description: Is enough context available to understand and reuse the dataset correctly?

questions.text: Is a clear reuse licence provided?
questions.recommendation: Add a clear and recognised reuse licence.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the licence name or SPDX identifier.

questions.text: Is the dataset's origin or provenance documented?
questions.recommendation: Document who created the dataset, how and from which sources.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide provenance, publisher or funding information.

questions.text: Is a version or release date provided?
questions.recommendation: Add version and release information.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the version or release date.

questions.text: Is there a useful description or README?
questions.recommendation: Add a README or detailed description.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the README or dataset description.

questions.text: Are limitations and intended uses documented?
questions.recommendation: Document known limitations, suitable uses and unsuitable uses.
questions.evidence_hint: Point to a limitations or intended-use section.

questions.text: Does the dataset follow relevant community standards?
questions.recommendation: Identify relevant disciplinary standards, schemas or conventions.
questions.evidence_hint: Name the standard, schema or community convention.

sections.title: AI Readiness
sections.short_description: Can the dataset be interpreted and used responsibly in AI workflows?

questions.text: Can the dataset or metadata be processed programmatically?
questions.recommendation: Provide machine-readable metadata and files.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the machine-readable format or endpoint.

questions.text: Are the files suitable for automated processing?
questions.recommendation: Provide files in documented, machine-processable formats.
questions.evidence_hint: List formats such as CSV, JSON, Parquet or XML.

questions.text: Is there enough documentation to interpret the dataset?
questions.recommendation: Add a README explaining the dataset and intended use.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the README or documentation URL.

questions.text: Are fields, labels and variables explained?
questions.recommendation: Add a data dictionary, schema or codebook.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the data dictionary or schema.

questions.text: Are quality checks or validation procedures documented?
questions.recommendation: Document validation, cleaning and quality-control steps.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe quality checks and validation results.

questions.text: Are bias, representativeness or coverage limits documented?
questions.recommendation: Document representativeness, exclusions and known bias.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide a bias or representativeness statement.

questions.text: Is the current version or update status clear?
questions.recommendation: State the current version and update date.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the version or update date.

sections.title: Responsible Licensing
sections.short_description: Are permissions, rights and possible harms clear enough for responsible reuse?

questions.text: Is the licence recognised and understandable?
questions.recommendation: Use a recognised licence and state it clearly.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide the licence name or SPDX identifier.

questions.text: Are attribution requirements clear?
questions.recommendation: State how the dataset should be credited.
questions.evidence_hint: Provide citation or attribution instructions.

questions.text: Are commercial-use conditions clear?
questions.recommendation: Clarify whether commercial reuse is allowed.
questions.evidence_hint: State the commercial-use condition.

questions.text: Are adaptation conditions clear?
questions.recommendation: Clarify whether adaptations and derivatives are allowed.
questions.evidence_hint: State the adaptation condition.

questions.text: Has permission for the intended AI use been confirmed?
questions.recommendation: Confirm that the intended AI use is permitted by all relevant rights and terms.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe the intended AI use and permission basis.

questions.text: Has the dataset been checked for personal or sensitive data?
questions.recommendation: Complete a privacy and sensitive-data review before reuse.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe consent, anonymisation or the privacy review.

questions.text: Have third-party rights and contractual restrictions been reviewed?
questions.recommendation: Review contracts, database rights and third-party content.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe the rights and contract review.

questions.text: Have foreseeable misuse and harmful-use risks been considered?
questions.recommendation: Document foreseeable misuse and suitable safeguards.
questions.evidence_hint: Describe misuse risks and mitigation measures.
